Gaming & Emulation

Gaming & Emulation apps for Omarchy

19 packages from the official Omarchy repository.

Reviewed 2026-10-25 · independent editorial guide

Short answer

Install any of these with omarchy pkg add <name>. The list below has all 19 gaming & emulation packages in the official repo as of 2026-10-25.

Every gaming & emulation package

Listed alphabetically. Categories are this site's own grouping; the packages and versions come from pkgs.omarchy.org.

  • heroic-games-launcher-bin omarchy pkg add heroic-games-launcher-bin
    One free launcher for your Epic, GOG, and Amazon Prime game libraries.
  • libretro-cap32-git omarchy pkg add libretro-cap32-git
    Brings the classic Amstrad CPC home computer into RetroArch.
  • libretro-database-git omarchy pkg add libretro-database-git
    The shared catalog that lets RetroArch actually recognize your games.
  • libretro-fbneo-git omarchy pkg add libretro-fbneo-git
    Bringing the arcade to your living room, one CPS and Neo Geo board at a time.
  • libretro-uae-git omarchy pkg add libretro-uae-git
    A whole Commodore Amiga, folded into a single RetroArch core.
  • libretro-vice-x128-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x128-git
    Your Commodore 128, resurrected inside RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-x64-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x64-git
    The classic C64, running fast inside RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-x64dtv-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x64dtv-git
    The plug-and-play Commodore 64 console, emulated in RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-x64sc-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-x64sc-git
    The Commodore 64, emulated cycle-for-cycle inside RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-xcbm2-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-xcbm2-git
    Commodore's business-class 8-bit machine, alive again in RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-xcbm5x0-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-xcbm5x0-git
    The compact CBM-II, emulated inside RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-xpet-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-xpet-git
    One of Commodore's very first computers, running again in RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-xplus4-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-xplus4-git
    Bring the Commodore Plus/4 back to life inside RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-xscpu64-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-xscpu64-git
    Emulate the souped-up Commodore 64 SuperCPU inside RetroArch.
  • libretro-vice-xvic-git omarchy pkg add libretro-vice-xvic-git
    Play Commodore VIC-20 software straight from RetroArch.
  • minecraft-launcher omarchy pkg add minecraft-launcher
    Mojang's official launcher for downloading, updating, and starting Minecraft with your Microsoft account.
  • omakade omarchy pkg add omakade
    One local game library that pulls together every launcher you use.
  • retroarch-joypad-autoconfig-git omarchy pkg add retroarch-joypad-autoconfig-git
    Plug in a controller and RetroArch just knows what it is.
  • sunshine omarchy pkg add sunshine
    Turn your own PC into a private game-streaming server.
